findings.title: Scoring receipt input hash can identify different bytes from the scored batch
findings.trigger: Replace the input path after read_batch/score_frame but before receipt creation. The untouched public revision records the replacement hash while producing the original example output. CSV width validation and pandas parsing previously made separate passes over the same open file.
findings.expected_behavior: The input SHA-256 must identify the captured bytes used for validation, parsing and scoring.
findings.actual_behavior_before_fix: The receipt SHA-256 was computed from the current path after scoring, independently of the previously parsed bytes.
findings.impact: Incorrect batch provenance during concurrent input replacement; no model, policy or prediction calculation change is required.
findings.correction: Capture the input bytes once, parse CSV/Parquet from memory, return the snapshot hash and use it in both scoring receipts. Document snapshot memory usage.
findings.remaining_limitation: Snapshot memory is additional to the parsed batch. A concurrent write during the operating-system read can produce a mixed capture, but parsing and hashing identify that same capture.

findings.title: Public-content description omitted retained real UCI case metadata
findings.trigger: Inspect the public explanation metadata and split manifest from the fresh clone.
findings.expected_behavior: Public inventory statements distinguish synthetic scoring examples, benchmark IDs and the retained case labels/probabilities.
findings.actual_behavior_before_fix: README broadly stated that customer-level labels/audit exports were outside Git, while preserved metadata included four real public UCI policy-validation cases and explanation sample IDs.
findings.impact: Misleading minimization disclosure. No raw financial workbook, full customer export or private identity mapping was found in the public package.
findings.correction: Precisely disclose the retained benchmark metadata in README/publication guide; preserve historical evidence bytes.
findings.verification: Public file inventory inspected; five-member archive contains no case records or source workbook; preserved report hashes unchanged.

findings.title: Historical personal execution paths remain in public files and history
findings.trigger: Bounded path-pattern inspection of the current public files and all reachable public history.
findings.expected_behavior: Delivery documentation should accurately disclose retained execution details, without implying private paths are usable dependencies of public scoring.
findings.actual_behavior_before_fix: 33 matching locations in 21 files contain personal execution paths despite broader exclusion wording.
findings.impact: Local execution information remains exposed; referenced private dependencies cannot support a public historical replay. Public scoring does not require them.
findings.correction: Correct the publication guide disclosure. Do not redact hash-bound historical receipts or rewrite public history during this audit.
findings.proposed_owner_action: If minimization beyond the current retained history is desired, choose a separately versioned public presentation and history policy without falsifying original receipts.

findings.title: Repository-wide code reuse license is undeclared
findings.trigger: Inspect tracked inventory and project metadata: no LICENSE file and no project license declaration.
findings.expected_behavior: Any intended code reuse permission should be stated by the rights owner, separately from data/model attribution.
findings.actual_behavior: UCI DOI/CC BY 4.0 data and model notices exist, but do not declare a repository-wide code license.
findings.impact: Inspection and scoring can be validated, while general third-party code reuse terms remain unspecified.
findings.correction: No license chosen during the audit; record as an owner decision.

findings.title: Individual bootstrap replicate statistics are unavailable
findings.trigger: Inspect preserved bootstrap outputs and runtime evidence for replicate-level statistics.
findings.expected_behavior: Independent percentile endpoint recomputation requires the individual saved replicate statistics; unavailable evidence must be identified.
findings.actual_behavior: 341 interval entries and undefined-count summaries are retained, but no individual replicate statistic arrays were found.
findings.impact: CSV/JSON interval consistency and construction can be checked; independent percentile/plan replay is not established.
findings.correction: Report the limit; do not regenerate bootstrap samples or modify accepted intervals.

findings.title: Scoring output files are not an atomic directory transaction
findings.trigger: Inject OSError while writing quarantined.csv after scored.csv has been written.
findings.expected_behavior: Callers need an unambiguous completion signal and must not treat partial output as a completed run.
findings.actual_behavior: A failed new directory can contain scored.csv without receipt.json; the error propagates and the existing destination prevents an overwrite/retry.
findings.impact: Consumers ignoring the receipt can use incomplete output; retries require a new destination.
findings.correction: Document receipt.json as the completion marker, possible partial output, and a new destination on retry. Preserve collision guards; no speculative transaction refactor.
